evidence.quoted_text: matches = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('ExecStart=')]
evidence.reason: The current renderer still identifies ExecStart directives with `line.startswith('ExecStart=')`, which rejects valid systemd syntax such as `ExecStart = ...` as zero directives and triggers the exact-one validation error. This is an implementation defect in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement.
